name: Find Loaded Module (SA)
help: Finds loaded modules; Linux and macOS search only the current process.
long_help: On Windows, searches running processes for loaded DLL names and supports partial module and process-name filters. On Linux and macOS, performs a case-insensitive path search only in the current process using /proc/self/maps or dyld; the optional process filter must be empty or match the current process. Cross-process search is not supported on Linux or macOS.

arguments.name: modname
arguments.desc: Module name or partial match to search for (e.g., amsi.dll, ntdll)

arguments.name: procname
arguments.desc: Process name filter - only search processes matching this string (empty for all processes)
